::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/gateway_accounts"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gateway_key` | `string` | **yes** | A gateway key from `GET /v1/gateways`. A gateway with `available: false` is refused with a 400. One of `tmtest`, `stripe`, `paypal`, `razorpay`, `gocardless`, `braintree`, `cashfree`, `adyen`, `checkoutcom`, `authorizenet`, `square`, `mollie`, `payu`, `cybersource`. |
| `label` | `string` | **yes** | A name for the gateway account. |
| `credentials` | `object` | no | Write-only. Encrypted at rest and never echoed back. |
| `currencies` | `array of string` | no | The currencies this account charges in (ISO-4217 codes). |
| `method_types` | `array of string` | no | The payment method types this account accepts. |
| `international_enabled` | `boolean` | no | International payments, for a gateway whose `international_domestic_currency` is set (Razorpay, Cashfree). False: the account takes only that currency, to save a payment method or to pay now. Enable it only after the gateway enables international payments on your account. Default false. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Invalid body |
| `404` | No such business |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/gateway_accounts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "gateway_key": "tmtest",
    "label": "Brightwater Analytics"
  }'
```
